profile.headline: Software Engineer @Techforce, US Treasury
profile.summary:
SWE @ Defense Tech | Autonomous vehicles | Augmented and Virtual Reality.

There’s nothing more rewarding than building and solving problems. I move fast, thrive in ambiguity, and enjoy turning zero-to-one ideas into products that make a meaningful impact. Always happy to chat, so feel free to reach out.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
GS-14 @ United States Treasury
- I cut government contracts and build it myself. 
- Why pay a contractor 20M for 2 years when you can build cheaper enterprise software with startup speed.
- Infrastructure, AI engineer, Full stack

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
CORVO Autonomous Vehicles - Founding Software Engineer
• Founding engineer on internal startup building a secure cloud platform for managing autonomous vehicle fleets at scale.
• Built a multi tenant system using React, AWS Lambda, IoT Core, and Terraform, enabling scalable device orchestration. 
• Architected backend services. Developed security scanning pipelines for continuous compliance.
  
HERMES Product Intelligence Platform - Lead Engineer
• Owned lifecycle of an enterprise platform that unifies company internal IP, proposal assets, tech capabilities, and investments. 
• Used by executives to manage multi-million dollar tech investments. Eliminated firm wide fragmentation, reduced RFP development time by ~2.5 weeks and drove adoption across 15+ leadership chains within 2 months.
• Built out entire full-stack platform using React, Flask, SQL, Terraform with a CI/CD pipeline and deployed on Azure. 

Ventures & Accelerator Team - Technical Product Strategist
• Drive product and technical strategy for in house startups. Perform technical/product diligence for integration, incubation, or spinout. 
• Manage an $8M investment portfolio, evaluating ~100 startups and internal assets annually to allocate funding.
• Rapidly turn leadership ideas into MVPs and insights to shape multi-million-dollar strategy decisions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of a Meta Quest application (“CRYPTOvrse”) for Fidelity’s research lab (FCAT) to teach blockchain concepts.
• Became the first intern built solution featured in the quarterly report for its business impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Owned, architect, and developed an end to end Augmented Reality navigation app.
• Reduced navigation time by 60%. Eliminated the need for separate iOS/Android codebases. 
• Awarded by MITRE for the solution. Built using Unity, C#, Blender, Photoshop, RestAPIs, spatial anchors.

educations.schoolName: Johns Hopkins Whiting School of Engineering

organizations.description: Elected to UMD’s VSA’s Executive Board with a general student body of 1000+. Lead teams in planning activities, fundraisers, and large-scale public events. Maintain relations with the school, other campus organizations, and businesses. Manage budget, funds, and grants.
